scope: Actual exported GLB terrain, entire polygon_xy floor bounds including thresholds; visible_polygon does not exempt any residual

method.geometry: Indexed GLB primitives read via memory map; recursive node world matrices, column-major matrix and T@R@S quaternion transforms applied
method.coordinate_mapping: Floor metadata Blender (x,y,z) -> glTF/Godot (x,z,-y); ray coordinates are glTF world XZ with Y height
method.intersection: Barycentric height on every overlapping nonvertical triangle; highest hit equals downward ray from above all selected terrain
method.sampling: Regular grid, complete polygon edges, terrain vertices inside floor polygon, and all terrain-edge/floor-edge crossings. The latter include piecewise-linear overlap extrema.
method.boundary_ownership: Potentially high terrain faces intersect verified actual GLB floor-top triangles. Zero-area exterior/shared edges are excluded. Positive-area contacts entirely inside a computed float32 half-ULP band at an actual floor boundary are separately reported with original area/height/width and precision bounds. Every distinguishable positive-area overlap contributes its exact extrema. Unresolved floors retain conservative unfiltered checks.
method.coordinate_precision_rule: Per-accessor float32 nextafter spacing / 2, transformed by abs(node world matrix), projected onto each actual boundary segment normal. Every convex intersection vertex must fit that same closed-segment precision band. No fixed-width exemption and no change to the 1mm vertical threshold.
method.required_terrain_support: Every regular floor-grid point and every actual A04 foot point must hit a selected terrain cap; missing grid support also fails the audit
method.outside_extent_rule: After world transforms, skip triangles whose projected AABB cannot meet any audited floor; this avoids indexing the unrelated 1.4km outer landscape

A04_actual_chair_feet.method: Actual world-space chair vertices within 20mm of its lowest point, plus XY-connected foot-cluster centers

interpretation: No terrain hit is explicitly reported as absence of a selected terrain surface, never a fabricated low height. Missing regular-grid or chair-foot support fails passed; all additional unsupported extrema/boundary samples are also listed.
This clearance audit does not judge lighting or furniture appearance; bind it to native captures of the same GLB SHA256.
